html:
This sapa tour is designed for travelers who want to spend 3 days – 2 night in Sapa aiming at: Saving the time, visit the most popular travel sites in Sapa, stay overnight in a good hotel to be comfortable and visit Fansipan peak – “The roof of Indochina”, especially you can enjoy friendly services provided.

Itinerary

Day 1: Hanoi – Sapa – Cat Cat Village – Sapa

Meals Included: Lunch, Dinner

06:00 – 06:30 – Departure from Hanoi

Arrive at the bus station, board the sleeper bus, and begin the journey to Sapa via the Noi Bai – Lao Cai Expressway, the longest highway in Vietnam.

07:30 – 11:45 – Highway Journey

Travel to Lao Cai City with a comfort break along the way.

11:45 – 13:00 – Mountain Road to Sapa

Enjoy picturesque views of terraced valleys and highland landscapes as you approach Sapa.

13:00 – Arrival in Sapa Town

See ethnic minority groups in their colorful traditional costumes.

  • Welcome drink and tour briefing

  • Lunch with local Vietnamese dishes

  • Hotel check-in

14:30 – Visit Cat Cat Village

Take a short drive to the gate of Cat Cat Village, home of the Black H’Mong people.

Your local guide will introduce village life, customs, and the daily activities of the locals. Trek down to the valley to visit the waterfall and the French-built Hydroelectric Power Station. Take photos at the waterfall and bridge before trekking uphill back toward Sapa.

Trekking distance: 2.5 km (approx. 2 hours)

The driver will pick you up and return to Sapa Town.

16:30 – Return to Sapa

Have dinner and spend the night at the hotel. Free time to explore Sapa’s nightlife.

Day 2: Sapa – Glass Bridge – Lonely Tree – Silver Waterfall – Hanoi

Meals Included: Breakfast, Lunch

07:00 – Sunrise & Breakfast

Enjoy the refreshing morning views over Sapa’s mountains, then have breakfast at the hotel.

08:00 – Visit Dragon Cloud, Glass Bridge & O Quy Ho Pass

A sightseeing bus will take you to the Dragon Cloud tourist area, Lonely Tree, and Silver Waterfall.

Your trip includes a stop at the summit of O Quy Ho Pass (2,333 meters above sea level), one of Vietnam’s Four Great Passes, perfect for cloud hunting and panoramic photography.

At the Dragon Cloud Glass Bridge, you will:

  • Take photos at the vibrant outdoor staircase

  • Enjoy the thrilling elevator ride to the Hao Han Qiao Glass Bridge

  • Walk across the three-sided transparent glass bridge (768 meters long, 1,000 meters above the mountain slope)

You may also join optional activities available within the tourist zone.

11:30 – Return to the Hotel

Check out of the hotel.

12:00 – Lunch

Enjoy lunch at the hotel.

13:30 – Depart for Hanoi

Board the bus and return to Hanoi. Stop along the way to rest and shop for local specialties.

20:00 – Arrival in Hanoi

Arrive at the bus station. The tour ends.

Vietlook Travel looks forward to welcoming you again!

Included Services

  • Sleeper bus Hanoi – Sapa – Hanoi (no guide on the bus)

  • Sightseeing bus in Sapa according to itinerary

  • Local English-speaking guide in Sapa

  • 1 breakfast and 3 main meals

  • Entrance tickets: Cat Cat Village, Glass Bridge, Lonely Tree, Silver Waterfall

  • 3–4–5 star hotels (2 guests per room, or 3 guests if group has odd number)

  • Insurance under bus company policy

Excluded Services

  • Drinks during meals

  • Personal expenses outside itinerary

  • Single room surcharge

  • VAT

  • Guide on the Hanoi – Sapa – Hanoi bus

    • Single cabin: 12 USD per person (round trip)

    • Sharing cabin: 200,000 VND per person (one way)

  • VIP Dcar Limousine surcharge: 20 USD per person (round trip)

  • Luxury 28-seat Limousine Nouble: 16 USD per person (round trip)

Children Policy

  • Under 5 years old (or under 1 meter): Free of charge (sharing bed/bus with parents; applies for 2 adults + 1 child)

  • 5–8 years old: 75% of adult price, sharing bed with adult

  • 9 years old and above: Charged as adult

Surcharge Policy

  • Additional surcharges apply during national holidays

What to Bring

  • Warm clothing, scarf, hat (Sapa can be very cold between September–March)

  • Trekking shoes, sunglasses, sun cream, insect repellent

  • Cash in Vietnam Dong (banking services in Sapa are sometimes unstable; USD, EUR, AUD are accepted)
